release_notes:
1. Numeric Order ID in Purchase: ecommerce.transaction_id captures the internal numeric Order ID (e.g. 1225) instead of the alphanumeric reference for standard GA4/GTM reporting.
2. Preserved Reference for Back-Office: order_totals.order_reference continues to store the alphanumeric reference for audit trail.
